text: To construct a parallelogram equal to a given rectilinear figure in a given rectilinear angle.  Let $ABCD$ be the given rectilinear figure, and $E$ the given rectilinear angle. So it is required to construct a parallelogram equal to the rectilinear figure $ABCD$ in the given angle $E$.
Let $DB$ have been joined,
and let the parallelogram $FH$, equal to the triangle $ABD$, have been constructed in the angle $HKF$, which is equal to $E$ [Prop.~1.42].
And let the parallelogram $GM$, equal to the triangle $DBC$, have been applied to the straight-line $GH$ in the angle $GHM$, which is equal to $E$ [Prop.~1.44].
And since angle $E$ is equal to each of (angles) $HKF$ and $GHM$,  (angle) $HKF$ is thus also equal to $GHM$.
assertion: angle HKF is equal to angle GHM

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: angle $E$ is equal to each of (angles) $HKF$ and $GHM$

text: Let $KHG$ have been added to both.
assertion: adding KHG to both of HKF=GHM: sum FKH+KHG equals sum GHM+KHG

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: Let $KHG$ have been added to both.

text: Thus, (the sum of) $FKH$ and $KHG$ is equal to (the sum of) $KHG$ and $GHM$.
assertion: sum of angles FKH and KHG equals sum of KHG and GHM

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: (the sum of) $FKH$ and $KHG$ is equal to (the sum of) $KHG$ and $GHM$

text: But, (the sum of) $FKH$ and $KHG$ is equal to two right-angles [Prop.~1.29].
assertion: sum of angles FKH and KHG equals two right-angles

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: (the sum of) $FKH$ and $KHG$ is equal to two right-angles

text: Thus, (the sum of) $KHG$ and $GHM$ is also equal to two right-angles.
assertion: sum of angles KHG and GHM equals two right-angles

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: (the sum of) $KHG$ and $GHM$ is also equal to two right-angles

text: So two straight-lines, $KH$ and $HM$, not lying on the same side, make  adjacent angles with some straight-line $GH$,  at the point $H$ on it, (whose sum is) equal to two right-angles.
assertion: KH and HM on opposite sides make adjacent angles with GH at H whose sum is two right-angles

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: two straight-lines, $KH$ and $HM$, not lying on the same side, make  adjacent angles with some straight-line $GH$,  at the point $H$ on it, (whose sum is) equal to two right-angles

text: Thus, $KH$ is straight-on to $HM$ [Prop.~1.14].
And since the straight-line $HG$ falls across the parallels $KM$ and $FG$, the alternate angles $MHG$ and $HGF$ are equal to one another [Prop.~1.29].
assertion: alternate angles MHG and HGF are equal

spans.label: assumption
spans.text: the straight-line $HG$ falls across the parallels $KM$ and $FG$

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: alternate angles $MHG$ and $HGF$ are equal to one another

text: Let $HGL$ have been added to both.
assertion: adding HGL to both of MHG=HGF: sum MHG+HGL equals sum HGF+HGL

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: Let $HGL$ have been added to both.

text: Thus, (the sum of) $MHG$ and $HGL$ is equal to  (the sum of) $HGF$ and $HGL$.
assertion: sum of angles MHG and HGL equals sum of HGF and HGL

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: (the sum of) $MHG$ and $HGL$ is equal to  (the sum of) $HGF$ and $HGL$

text: But, (the sum of) $MHG$ and $HGL$ is equal to two right-angles [Prop.~1.29].
assertion: sum of angles MHG and HGL equals two right-angles

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: (the sum of) $MHG$ and $HGL$ is equal to two right-angles

text: Thus, (the sum of) $HGF$ and $HGL$ is also equal to two right-angles.
assertion: sum of angles HGF and HGL equals two right-angles

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: (the sum of) $HGF$ and $HGL$ is also equal to two right-angles

text: Thus, $FG$ is straight-on to $GL$ [Prop.~1.14].
And since $FK$ is equal and parallel to $HG$ [Prop.~1.34], but also $HG$ to $ML$ [Prop.~1.34], $KF$ is thus also equal and parallel to $ML$ [Prop.~1.30].
assertion: KF is equal and parallel to ML

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: $KF$ is thus also equal and parallel to $ML$

text: And the straight-lines $KM$ and $FL$ join them.
assertion: the straight-lines KM and FL join FK and ML

text: Thus, $KM$ and $FL$ are equal and parallel as well [Prop.~1.33].
assertion: KM and FL are equal and parallel

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: $KM$ and $FL$ are equal and parallel as well

text: Thus, $KFLM$ is a parallelogram.
And since triangle $ABD$ is equal to parallelogram $FH$, and $DBC$ to $GM$, the whole rectilinear figure $ABCD$ is thus equal to the whole parallelogram $KFLM$.
assertion: the whole rectilinear figure ABCD is equal to the whole parallelogram KFLM

spans.label: assertion
spans.text: the whole rectilinear figure $ABCD$ is thus equal to the whole parallelogram $KFLM$

text: Thus, the parallelogram $KFLM$, equal to the given rectilinear figure $ABCD$, has been constructed in the angle $FKM$, which is equal to the given (angle) $E$. (Which is) the very thing it was required to do.
